title: ID0422954-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PO 312567479/14]converter grouping error due to Q9-10
description:
Reported issue: At the charging station, when a charging session is initiated, the opposing charging point defaults. Example (charge on n•1 results in n•2 being faulty) Load test conducted on 07/05/25 between 1:00 PM and 1:30 PM. There may be an issue with authorization.
Solution: QA9-10 replace

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422954-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2 / PO 312567479/14 ]converter grouping error due to Q9-10 CRM:02684000200
additional_info.body:
Hello Romain Delphin,
As checked in logs from
2025-05-07T10:56:37.115643+00:00  to 2025-05-07T11:00:49.684968+00:00
Charging session started in DC1 at
2025-05-07T10:56:37.115643+00:00
with RFID Authorization:
04446832707380
Session started properly without any issue from SOC 70% later at
2025-05-07T10:57:46.176692+00:00 again authorization was done with same rfid:
04446832707380 which was accepted from backed for DC2.
charging process started in DC2 at
2025-05-07T10:57:46.176692+00:00
but was failed later due to Converter grouping error
CG at one end of faulty SMC is allotted to that outlet in CGp role, hence this CG is deactivated, CG Last used by: None
reason for the error was Q9-10 DC contactor feedback issue.
PLC Error Flag value: false->true, Name: DC_Contactor_MG1-MG2_QA9-10, Description: coontactor stuck at ON feedback
DC_Contactor_MG1-MG2_QA9-10 feedback error has appeared multiple times in past 15 days.
Solution: Q9-10 DC contactor needs to be replaced.
I will inform the region for DC contactor spare part order & site visit needed for contactor replacement.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma

change
the

replying
to it.
